Description for our service Kerojet specializes in delivering safe and efficient into-plane fueling services across Nigeria’s airports. The company operates a fleet of approximately 150 jet fuel-compliant trucks. Fueling operations are conducted either via tank trucks or through hydrant systems using dispensers. We offer into-plane fueling services to oil companies seeking to outsource their internal fueling operations or establish seamless operations at new locations without the complexities of setting up their own fueling infrastructure. For airlines, Kerojet provides the flexibility for clients to influence the pricing and quality of into-plane fueling services tailored to various aircraft types. Long-haul, short-haul, and general aviation Cargo and passenger airlines Fueling with static hydrant carts, hydrant dispensers, or refueler trucks with capacities of up to 85 m³ 📸 Our Operations in Action Explore our gallery showcasing Kerojet’s commitment to excellence — from state-of-the-art fueling trucks and on-ground operations to our expert team delivering aviation solutions across Nigeria’s major airports.
